reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Configure managed resource activation policies: Crossplane v2 automatically creates a default MRAP that activates all managed resources (`*`). Before…", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: Customization is optional; the default MRAP activating all managed resources (`*`) is created automatically and only affects cluster resource efficiency.

proposed.statement: Crossplane v2 automatically creates a default MRAP activating all managed resources (`*`); operators may optionally replace it with a targeted MRAP before installing v2 providers.
